title: Getting Started
text: main user-facing function xtrial(). simple call fits one comparison approach one estimator. example, following code fits TMLE estimator using direct pooled IPD comparison approach. Notice xtrial() returns: object containing point estimate, standard error, confidence interval, information fitted approach estimator. can store fitted object summarize :
code: fit <- xtrial(   data = dat,   approach = "direct",   estimator = "tmle",   nuisance_type = "simple" )  fit #>  #> xtrial object #>  #> Estimator: TMLE  #> Approach : Direct  #>  #> Estimate : 0.0140 #> SE       : 0.0488 #>  #> 95% CI: #> (-0.0816, 0.1097) summary(fit) #>   estimator approach   estimate         se      ci_low  ci_high #> 1      tmle   direct 0.01400569 0.04879952 -0.08163961 0.109651

title: xtrial
text: Cross-Trial Causal Comparison Multi-Arm Randomized Trials Heterogeneous Comparators xtrial R package causal inference evidence synthesis across randomized clinical trials share common active comparator. package developed support comparative effectiveness analyses multidrug-resistant tuberculosis (MDR/RR-TB) treatment regimens using individual participant data (IPD) endTB TB-PRACTECAL trials, methodology broadly applicable cross-trial comparisons medicine, public health, comparative effectiveness research.

title: xtrial
text: Many important clinical questions answered single randomized controlled trial. MDR/RR-TB, recent phase III trials demonstrated effectiveness several novel -oral regimens. However, clinically relevant comparison—effectiveness 6-month BPaLM regimen versus 9-month -oral regimens—never directly randomized. Traditional indirect comparisons, network meta-analysis, IPD meta-analysis typically rely common comparators strong homogeneity assumptions. assumptions often violated : trials evaluate different treatment sets, standards care vary across countries time, patient populations differ across studies, treatment effects may transport across trial populations. xtrial provides causal inference framework settings.

title: EIF-based direct estimator — eif_direct_est
text: dataset data frame containing outcome, treatment, trial indicator, baseline covariates. Must include variables y, treatment, s, L1, L2. a_val Character value indicating active treatment trial 1. Default "". b_val Character value indicating active treatment trial 2. Default "b". clamp Numeric vector length 2 giving lower upper bounds used truncate estimated probabilities. Default c(1e-6, 1 - 1e-6). nuisance_type Character string specifying nuisance estimation strategy. Options "simple" "flexible".

title: EIF-based direct estimator — eif_direct_est
text: list following components: eif estimated EIF contribution observation. estimate point estimate direct contrast. se_if Influence-function-based standard error. CI_if Wald-type 95\ componentsA data frame containing four EIF components. nuisance_typeThe nuisance estimation strategy used. Estimates direct cross-trial contrast using efficient influence function (EIF)-based estimator. estimator combines outcome regressions, within-trial treatment mechanisms, trial membership mechanism.   function estimates direct cross-trial contrast comparing treatment a_val trial 1 treatment b_val trial 2. fits following nuisance functions: treatment mechanism trial 1, treatment mechanism trial 2, outcome regression trial 1, outcome regression trial 2, trial membership mechanism.

title: EIF-based estimator of the indirect effect — eif_indirect_est
text: dataset data frame containing observed data. Must include variables y, treatment, s, L1, L2. Character value identifying active treatment trial 1. b Character value identifying active treatment trial 2. c1 Character value identifying standard--care treatment trial 1. c2 Character value identifying standard--care treatment trial 2. clamp Numeric vector length two specifying lower upper truncation bounds estimated probabilities. nuisance_type Character string indicating nuisance estimation strategy. Must one "simple" "flexible".

title: EIF-based estimator of the indirect effect — eif_indirect_est
text: list containing: indirect Estimated indirect effect. se_if Influence-function-based standard error. CI_if Wald-type 95\ eifEstimated efficient influence function values. thetaEstimated pathway-specific component \(\theta\). phiEstimated direct-effect component \(\phi\). nuisance_typeNuisance estimation strategy used. Estimates indirect effect combining EIF-based estimator pathway-specific contrast \(\theta\) EIF-based estimator direct contrast \(\phi\).   Specifically, $$ \psi_{\mathrm{indirect}} = \theta + \phi. $$indirect effect estimated sum : EIF-based estimator \(\theta\), obtained eif_theta_est(), EIF-based estimator direct contrast \(\phi\), obtained eif_direct_est().

title: EIF-based estimator of the indirect pathway contrast (\(\theta\)) — eif_theta_est
text: estimator combines: treatment propensity models within trial, outcome regression models within trial, trial membership model \(P(S=1\mid L)\). Outcome regressions fit separately within trial evaluated treatment level interest. Treatment propensity models estimated separately within trial, trial membership model estimated using pooled data. Standard errors computed empirical variance estimated EIF divided sample size.

title: Main interface for cross-trial comparison estimators — xtrial
text: data data frame containing trial indicator, treatment, outcome, baseline covariates. approach Identification strategy. One "traditional", "observational", "direct", "indirect". estimator Estimation method. One "ipw", "gcomp", "onestep", "tmle". nboot Number bootstrap samples bootstrap-based estimators. nuisance_type Nuisance estimation type. Currently mainly used one-step/EIF TMLE estimators; one "simple" "flexible".
